sql:
SELECT
  carrier,
  COUNT(*) AS shipments_shipped,
  COUNT(delivered_at) AS shipments_delivered,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN delivered_at IS NOT NULL THEN (delivered_at::date - shipped_at::date) END)::numeric, 2) AS avg_transit_days,
  ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (delivered_at::date - shipped_at::date)) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL))::numeric, 2) AS median_transit_days,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND (delivered_at::date - shipped_at::date) <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(delivered_at), 0), 1) AS pct_within_3_days,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS share_of_total_shipments_pct
FROM shipments
WHERE shipped_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND shipped_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY carrier
ORDER BY shipments_shipped DESC, carrier ASC
